name: Entreat the Angels
oracle_text:
Create X 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying.
Miracle {X}{W}{W} (You may cast this card for its miracle cost when you draw it if it's the first card you drew this turn.)
blocked_sentences: Miracle {X}{W}{W} (You may cast this card for its miracle cost when you draw it if it's the first card you drew this turn.)

needs.what: a miracle cost containing {X}: when the miracle cast is offered on the draw, the player chooses X (bounded by what they can pay), pays {X}{W}{W} with that X, and the spell goes on the stack with item.x set so 'Create X ... tokens' reads the chosen value
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The card-level `miracle` rider is accepted, but replacements._offer_cast builds Cost(mana=cost) and calls stack.push_spell without an `x`, so X defaults to 0: the miracle cast would pay only {W}{W} and create zero Angels, the card's whole point. No shipped miracle card has an X cost (only Molecule Man's granted {0})
